projects.title: Aethelgard Botanical Spirits
projects.imageAlt: Luxury amber glass bottle with custom embossed foil label
projects.overview: A premium packaging and visual identity system crafted for high-altitude botanical gin distillers. Featuring tactile debossing, warm copper foils, and bespoke botanical typography.
projects.approach: We immersed ourselves in the sub-alpine flora harvested for Aethelgard. The resulting label design balances heritage apothecary craftsmanship with minimalist modern silhouettes, resulting in an extraordinary shelf presence that increased distributor pre-orders by 340%.

projects.title: Kromos Audio Spatial System
projects.imageAlt: Monochromatic futuristic sound hardware branding with electric orange accents
projects.overview: A complete sonic and visual identity overhaul for next-generation spatial acoustics hardware, bridging high-end industrial engineering with visceral audio sensations.
projects.approach: Leveraging brutalist geometry paired with high-voltage neon orange accents against obsidian textures. The dynamic waveform motif flexes from physical anodized aluminum volume dials to responsive screen interfaces.

projects.title: Vanguard Architectural Studio
projects.imageAlt: Minimalist editorial architecture monograph and web experience
projects.overview: Digital experience and physical exhibition collateral designed for an award-winning brutalist architecture collective.
projects.approach: Structured around golden-ratio grid systems with generous white-space (or black-space in dark mode), fluid masonry transitions, and high-fidelity project walkthroughs.

projects.title: SOCIAL MEDIA POSTERS
projects.imageAlt: High-contrast editorial social campaign for avant-garde haute couture
projects.overview: A hyper-stylized social media campaign and digital invitation suite for NeoLuxe Autumn/Winter runway preview.
projects.approach: We synchronized grain-textured film photography with razor-sharp kinetic typography in electric vermilion. The campaign generated over 2.4M organic impressions across fashion platforms within 72 hours.

projects.title: Solstice Biocare Organics
projects.imageAlt: Minimalist dark cosmetic serum bottles with vibrant terracotta labels
projects.overview: Sustainable luxury packaging system incorporating compostable mycelium packaging and recycled violet glass.
projects.approach: Proved that sustainable skincare does not require rustic compromises. The identity blends clinical purity with warm solar gradients, creating a category-defining cosmetic brand.

projects.title: Orbit Pay Global Fintech
projects.imageAlt: Dynamic 3D fluid geometric logo monogram in radiant orange and charcoal
projects.overview: Brand mark and trademark architecture for an international cross-border liquidity engine serving emerging markets.
projects.approach: Constructed an unbroken topological loop conveying continuous circulation, infinite movement, and cryptographic trust. Scalable from a 16px favicon to monumental airport billboard campaigns.

process.headline: A deliberate process for exceptional results.
process.description: Three focused phases designed to eliminate guesswork, inspire creative breakthroughs, and deliver bulletproof design solutions.

steps.title: Discover
steps.subtitle: Understand the business, audience, and goals.
steps.description: We begin with deep immersion into your enterprise. Through stakeholder discovery workshops, competitive audits, and audience sentiment analysis, we establish the strategic anchor points that guide every creative decision.

steps.title: Design
steps.subtitle: Develop concepts and refine the visual direction.
steps.description: We explore divergent creative territories, translating strategic insight into tangible visual concepts. Through iterative design sprints, we refine logos, color schemes, typography systems, and tactile packaging until the brand identity is unmistakably powerful.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.subtitle: Prepare final assets and support the launch.
steps.description: Flawless production handoff. We author comprehensive brand books, generate complete vector and raster asset libraries, coordinate with specialized print vendors, and provide ongoing launch support to guarantee seamless implementation.

tasks.title: Vesper Botanical Luxury Skincare Packaging
tasks.brief: Design sustainable folding carton packaging with blind debossing and copper foil accents for Vesper's night restorative serum. We want tactile luxury using FSC certified uncoated black paperboard.
tasks.deliverables: Complete packaging dieline design, embossing die production guides, and photorealistic 3D presentation renders.
tasks.fileFormats: AI master dielines with separate spot layers, Print PDF, 4x 3D JPG renders (1920x1080)

submissions.notes: Initial carton architecture with copper hot-stamping on 380gsm black linen board. Included two variations for the top tuck flap seal.
submissions.adminFeedback:
The overall material choice and copper foil treatment look exquisite. However, please make two critical adjustments:
1. Increase the tracking on the French ingredient text on the left panel (currently too dense for foil debossing).
2. Reposition the batch verification QR square to the bottom flap so the exterior panels remain completely minimal.
